title: Birdeye Pricing & Plans | Review Management Software Pricing | Birdeye

facts.fact: Birdeye's pricing page displays a metric of 98.5K mobile Google Map impressions, presented as a platform result without a stated time period.
Birdeye's pricing page displays a metric of 94.7K visitors clicking "call," presented as a platform result without a stated time period.
Birdeye's pricing page displays a metric of 15.3K reviews with a 4.6 star rating, presented as a platform result without a stated time period.
The Birdeye pricing request form offers location-count bands of 1-3, 4-9, 10-39, 40-249, 250-999, and 1000+ locations.
Birdeye states its pricing is built around outcomes rather than seat counts.
Birdeye describes its offering as one platform on one contract, where customers pay only for what they deploy at their locations.
facts.quote:
One platform, one contract - replace point products and pay only   
for what you deploy at your locations

facts.fact: Birdeye's page claims it is ranked #1 on G2, a claim the vendor makes about itself rather than a figure from an independent source.
facts.quote: #1 on G2. Proven where it matters.

facts.fact: A Valley Veterinary Care customer quoted on Birdeye's page is cited as reporting a 400% increase in social publishing after using Birdeye Social.
Birdeye's page states that the copyright notice reads © 2026 Birdeye Inc.
